brief:
Amer Badran, a Palestinian poet and physician, has released a new poetry collection in translation titled "In My Kitchen," according to ArabLit. Badran has published six poetry collections throughout his career, combining his dual work as a doctor and literary figure.

The collection represents the latest addition to Badran's body of work, extending his presence in translated Arabic poetry to English-language readers.
dek: Amer Badran is Palestinian poet and doctor. He has six poetry collections.
title: Palestinian poet Amer Badran publishes new translated poetry collection
